title: Proper pushforward preserves ambient coproducts on the constructible finite-Tor localizing hull over a qcqs base
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a fixed algebraic closure, and an admissible commutative condensed ring $\Lambda$: a finite commutative ring annihilated by a power of $\ell$, or $\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, with exactly the discrete or induced $\ell$-adic topological condensed-ring convention of [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ and $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$, the ordinary unbounded module-object derived category [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], with the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the finite constant scalar-model constructibility and finite Tor amplitude of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Let $S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, $q:Y\to S$ proper and $f:X\to Y$ proper. Write $\mathcal L_X=\operatorname{Loc}(\mathrm D_{\mathrm{ctf}}(X,\Lambda))$ for the full replete triangulated hull closed under small coproducts in $D_X$ [sk-def-localizing-closure]. For every small set $I$ and every family $(L_t)_{t\in I}$ in $\mathcal L_X$, the canonical map induced by the coprojections
$$\bigoplus_{t\in I}Rf_*L_t\longrightarrow Rf_*\left(\bigoplus_{t\in I}L_t\right)$$
is an isomorphism in $D_Y$. Both coproducts are ambient ordinary derived-category coproducts in the fixed indexing universe, including the empty family. No common cohomological bounds on the family and no derived completeness of its sum are assumed. No field, characteristic, Noetherian or finite-dimensional-base hypothesis is imposed.
